About

Thanks for stopping by. Read below to learn more about myself and my background.

Background

I'm Rahmad Al Habib Khasary, a full stack developer based in Cibinong, Bogor, Indonesia. I've been building software since 2016 — starting as a freelance developer, then working across agencies and enterprises as a senior programmer, and now as a full stack developer at ALSOK Indonesia, where I own internal applications used by roughly 30,000 employees: attendance, carpooling, e-learning, and an integrated facility management system.

My comfort zone is the whole stack: Laravel and React on a typical day, React Native or Flutter when it needs to run on a phone, Electron for desktop, and Node-RED or Python when the job involves hardware and integrations. I've shipped enterprise systems, client freelance projects, and small-business apps — each one teaches a different kind of discipline.

These days I'm also building Bulbulls, a game top-up store, from an accepted proposal toward go-live — dynamic pricing, automatic supplier failover, and multi-payment gateway architecture. When I'm not writing code, I'm usually hunting for freelance gigs or tinkering with self-hosted tooling.
